Definition: from G1722 and G3306; to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere:--continue.
BiblicalUsage: Emmeno means to stay put — to continue in something rather than drift from it. Paul and Barnabas urge the new disciples to continue in the faith in Acts 14:22, and Paul warns that the one who does not continue in all the law is cursed in Galatians 3:10. The sad side is in Hebrews 8:9, where Israel continued not in God's covenant, and the quiet side is Paul dwelling two whole years in his own hired house in Acts 28:30.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe continuing is the real test of faith — starting is easy, staying is hard. I hold that God keeps those who keep on with Him, and the promise in Acts is that continuing in the faith is the road into the kingdom, tribulation and all.
